scope: XGComputeTexture1DLayout (ordinal 4) and XGCreateTexture1DComputer (ordinal 8) for a bounded subset. Identical guest and XMem dependency; complete layouts and sampled element addresses compared against the supplied Xbox XG DLL.
subset: 57 uncompressed color formats; seven widths including 1, 2 and 16,384; one or three mips and slices; shader-resource bind; linear swizzle with default, immutable or staging usage; no CPU access flags, misc flags or explicit pitch. Block-compressed formats and other combinations are unsupported.
